title: Streamlining Project Documentation Retrieval in SharePoint
business: Project managers and technical leads in large organizations who rely on SharePoint for document storage.
problem: Users struggle with fragmented information, spending excessive time manually navigating nested folder hierarchies to locate specific project requirements or status reports.
solution: The Microsoft SharePoint app connector for ChatGPT enables natural language queries to search, retrieve, and summarize content directly from SharePoint sites, bypassing manual navigation.
steps: Authenticate the ChatGPT session with the Microsoft SharePoint app connector using organizational credentials.
Define the specific SharePoint site URL or library scope within the connector configuration settings.
Submit natural language queries to the chat interface to identify and extract relevant project documents.
Review the retrieved document summaries or direct links provided by the AI to verify accuracy.
outcome: Improved operational efficiency by reducing the time spent on manual document discovery and enhancing the speed of information synthesis for project stakeholders.
limitation: The connector is limited by the configured permissions of the authenticated user; if a user lacks read access to a specific library, the AI cannot retrieve or summarize those documents, which can be verified by checking the SharePoint site's access control lists.

questions.question: In Streamlining Project Documentation Retrieval in SharePoint, what is a key limitation of the connector?
options: It can only retrieve documents created in the last 30 days.
It requires the user to have administrative rights to the entire tenant.
It is restricted by the user's existing SharePoint permissions.
It cannot provide direct links to the retrieved documents.
questions.explanation: The connector respects existing security settings, meaning it cannot access what the user cannot access.
